sentences.text: This application for bail under Section 483 BNSS has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.165/2025 registered at Police Station Bichiwada, District Dungarpur, for the offences under Sections 366, 376(d), 506/34 of IPC.

Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner, this Court finds that as per the prosecution case,
on 09.05.2025, the petitioner along with the co-accused persons forcibly abducted the victim and thereafter took her to the premises of Government Primary School, Kabada Falla, where she was subjected to forcible sexual assault.

This Court, upon a careful perusal of the medical examination report of the victim as well as the statement of the doctor, Nisha Patidar (PW-09), who conducted the medical examination of the victim, finds that the allegations of forcible (Uploaded on 04/02/2026 at 04:46:32 PM) [2026:RJ-JD:6447] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-8591/2025] sexual assault levelled by the victim against the accused persons are duly corroborated by the medical evidence.

sentences.text: In the opinion of this Court, when the allegations of forcible sexual assault are corroborated by medical evidence and the testimony of the examining doctor, there is no reason for this Court to disbelieve the statement of the victim or the allegations levelled by her against the accused persons under the relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS).

5. This Court, having regard to the seriousness of the allegations levelled against the present petitioner and the supporting medical evidence on record, is not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
6. Consequently, the second bail application filed on behalf of the petitioner is dismissed.
